subject: Save and Quit
text: Saving and quitting restarts Young Link at Link's House in Kokiri Forest, or Adult Link at the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote:
One you exit the game after saving the game will either put you at the start of the dungeon or:
- Young link: Link's House[Kokiri Forest] 
- Adult Link: Temple of Time

subject: Fairies
text: Using a fairy does not count towards the death count, acting as an extra life system.

evidence.quote: Don't be afraid to use fairy's as an extra life system, using a fairy doesn't count towards the death count so the more bottles you have the more extra lives you are holding!

subject: Farore's Wind
text: Setting Farore's Wind before entering a boss room shortens runbacks if an attempt fails.

evidence.quote: Before going to a boss, save before you go into the boss room and use Farore's Wind to shorten runbacks.. If you failed the missable, reset the game and go back to the save to try again.

subject: Deku Scrub Merchant
text: A Deku Scrub Merchant across a bridge down a ladder in the Lost Woods sells a Deku Stick Upgrade for 40 rupees.

evidence.quote: After getting the Kokiri Sword and Deku Shield, head up top to the Lost Woods. From there take a left, pass the skull kid on the left side. Climb the ladder down into the room with the bridge leading to a Deku Scub Merchant asking for 40 rupees for the Deku Stick Upgrade.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: Queen Gohma can be defeated in one rotation before retreating to the ceiling by stunning her eye with the slingshot, jump slashing with a Deku Stick for double damage, and mashing the stick button three times.

evidence.quote: Deku Sticks are the key to defeating this boss in one rotation. sticks hold more damage between the Kokiri Sword. As soon as the boss starts, use your sling shot on the bosses eye to stun the boss while on the ground. Jump slash with a stick out to do double damage, then mash the stick button to hit the boss three times with the deku stick.

subject: Spiritual Stone of the Forest
text: The Spiritual Stone of the Forest is received after defeating Gohma in the Deku Tree.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After defeating Gohma in the Deku Tree.

subject: Town Shooting Gallery
text: The Town Shooting Gallery costs 20 rupees for 15 bullets to shoot 10 targets, with shooting 8 of 10 targets awarding a free retry.

evidence.quote: Upon entering the Hyrule castle to the left of Malon you will see the Town Shooting Gallery, spend 20 rupees and shoot all the rupees to win. 15 bullets, 10 targets and if you shoot 8/10 you get your next try on the house for free.

subject: Courtyard Guard
text: Talking to the guard on the left upon entering Hyrule Courtyard, getting caught, leaving, and returning allows paying a fee to open the gate.

evidence.quote:
[Missable] Upon entering Hyrule Courtyard there is a guard on the left you need to talk, get caught leave the area. Once you come back, you should be able to talk to the guard pay a small fee and the gate will be open.

 - Why [M]? After you go to courtyard you can't trigger this dialogue.

subject: Talon
text: Talking to Malon at night outside Hyrule Castle grants a Cucco Egg, which hatches into a Cucco by morning to wake her father sleeping next to milk crates in Hyrule Courtyard.

evidence.quote: After re-entering the grounds to the castle you will see Malon at night time talking to her gets you the Cucco Egg, walk all the up to the Hyrule Courtyard with your new egg to find Malon's Father sleeping next to some milk crates. Use the Cucco after the egg has hatched due the morning use to to walk up her father.

subject: Castle Guard
text: Shooting the window to the left with a slingshot right before speaking to Princess Zelda angers a guard, triggering a dialogue before collecting all 3 spiritual stones.

evidence.quote:
[Missable] Right before talking to princess Zelda, if you shoot the window to the left with a slingshot a small dialogue will appear.  

 - Why [M]? You can not come back to this area after collecting all 3 spiritual stones.

subject: Princess Zelda
text: Princess Zelda is met for the first time after passing the Hyrule Courtyard.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After Hyrule Courtyard.

subject: Graveyard Grotto
text: Pulling the gravestone with flowers in front of it at night in Kakariko Village Graveyard reveals a hidden grotto containing a chest with a Hylian Shield.

evidence.quote: After Obtaining Zelda's Lullaby go to Kakariko Village Graveyard and obtain the Sun Song. Enter the graveyard at night and pull the gravestone with the flowers in front of it to reveal a hidden grotto. A chest with a Hylian Shield is inside.

subject: Anju
text: Anju rewards Link for returning seven lost Cuccos located across Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: Talk to Anju at Kakariko Village to help her find her lost seven Cuccos are the village

subject: Cuccos
text: Attacking cuccos repeatedly with a sword triggers the cucco revenge swarm.

evidence.quote: Simply hit the cuccos with your sword until you witness the full wrath of the cuccos.

subject: Darunia
text: Visiting Darunia in Goron City after learning Saria's Song in the Sacred Forest Meadow yields a progression gift.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] Inside Goron City after learning Saria's Song in the Sacred Forest Meadow.

subject: Target Tree
text: Shooting the circular tree target three times upon entering the Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest awards a Bullet Bag upgrade.

evidence.quote: As soon as you enter the Lost Woods from Kokiri Forest turn right and shoot the circle target holding by the tree in the middle three times.

subject: Ocarina Playing Minigame
text: Playing the ocarina on the tree stump next to the Bullet Bag upgrade area initiates a memorization minigame for a reward.

evidence.quote: Next to where you obtained the Bullet Bag upgrade, on the bottom section use your ocarina on the tree stump to play a memorization minigame.

subject: Super Cucco Catching
text: Pressing the shield button while holding a Cucco performs a shield drop to release it faster, and previously picked Cuccos display a green arrow above them.

evidence.quote: Huge Tip:  You can shield drop the cuccos to drop them faster (that's just pressing shield while holding something). Also, if you've already picked up a cucco a green arrow will be above it, so you know not to pick it up again.

subject: Barn Cow
text: Playing Epona's Song in front of a cow inside the barn with an empty bottle yields nutritious milk.

evidence.quote: After obtaining Epona's Song at Lon Lon Ranch, go to the Barn inside the Ranch and play Epona's Song in front of a cow with an empty bottle.

subject: Happy Mask Shop
text: Handing Zelda's Letter to the guard at the Death Mountain Trail entrance unlocks the Happy Mask side quest in Hyrule Castle Town.

evidence.quote: After Handing Zelda's Letter to the Guard at Death Mountain Trail Entrance in Kakariko Village, you locked a side quest for the Happy Mask story in Hyrule Castle.

subject: Butterfly Grotto
text: Wearing the Skull Mask inside the hidden grotto surrounded by grass and butterflies near two Deku Scrubs awards the final Deku Stick upgrade.

evidence.quote: In the Lost Woods, there is a section with two Deku Scrubs and a tree surrounded by grass. Once you find butterflies flying around the grass, use that to negative your self to find the hidden grotto. Upon arriving in the grotto, use the skull mask to obtain the Final Deku Stick Upgrade.

subject: King Dodongo
text: King Dodongo can be defeated without using bombs from your bag by throwing bomb flowers, jump slashing with a stick, and cancelling his fire breath with the slingshot.

evidence.quote: [Missable] As soon as you start the fight, turn around and grab a bomb flower run towards the boss to time your throw right. Jump slash with the stick then repeat the process once more to kill the boss, don't worry about getting hit. If the boss is about to fire, us the slingshot to cancel the effect.

subject: Spiritual Stone of Fire
text: The Spiritual Stone of Fire is received upon defeating King Dodongo.

evidence.quote: [Story Progression] After defeating King Dodongo.

subject: Great Fairy Fountain
text: Blowing up the rock next to Rauru at the top of Death Mountain opens the Fairy Fountain to learn the Spin Attack.

evidence.quote: Climb the top of Death Mountain, blow up the rock next to Rauru to enter the fairy Fountain.

subject: Boulder Room
text: Reaching the boulder room chests across the tightrope at the top of Goron City without destroying the entrance blockade requires navigating the interior using bombs.

evidence.quote:
[Missable] On the top of Goron City there is tightrope, slowly make your way around till you see an area with tons of rocks. Use your bombs in that room to reach the chest. 

 - Why [M]? Blowing up the rocks on the left of the tightrope voids this achievement and they do not respawn.

subject: Rolling Goron
text: Detonating a bomb to stop the massive rolling Goron while he is inside the small cave yields the Bomb Bag upgrade.

evidence.quote: In the Goron City you will see a massive goron rolling around, you have to use your bombs to blow up the goron while he is inside the small cave. It can be a little tricky, but timing is key to make sure he lands inside the cave.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: The Bombchu Bowling Alley minigame unlocks after obtaining bombs and awards bombchus, a bomb bag upgrade, and a heart piece.

evidence.quote: While in Hyrule Castle there is a mini game that is unlocked after obtaining the bombs where you can get bombchus, bomb bag upgrade and a heart piece.

subject: White Dog
text: At night, a white dog left of the entrance leading to Hyrule Field will follow Link into an alley door to return to its owner.

evidence.quote: Inside the Hyrule Castle at night time, there is a white dog left of the entrance that leads to the Hyrule Field. Walk over to the white dog and have to follow you. Lead the dog to the right down the alley, after the first section go inside the first door you see. You will talk to the lady that is trying to find her lost dog.

subject: Great Fairy Fountain
text: Blowing up the rock past the gate in Hyrule Courtyard reveals a Fairy Fountain where Din's Fire is learned.

evidence.quote: Inside Hyrule Courtyard, past the gate where you bribe the guard blow up the rock leading to the Fairy Fountain.

subject: Deku Scrub
text: Blowing up the rock before the entrance to Sacred Forest Meadow reveals a hidden grotto where the Deku Scrub on the left sells a Deku Nuts upgrade.

evidence.quote: In the Lost Woods, before the entrance leading to Sacred Forest Meadow blow up the rock to lead down a hidden grotto. Talk to the Deku Scrub on the left to get your Deku Nuts Upgrade.

subject: Magic Bean Salesman
text: Blowing up the rocks on Zora's River allows talking to the Magic Bean Salesman to obtain Magic Beans.

evidence.quote: Right after blowing up the rocks on Zora's River talk to the Magic Bean Salesman to get your Magic Beans.

subject: Zora Diving Minigame
text: Speaking to the Zora Guard on the left after King Zora in Zora's Domain allows playing the diving minigame to collect rupees for a reward.

evidence.quote: After talking to King Zora inside Zora's Domain on the left is a Zora Guard. Play the mini game and grab all the rupees to obtain your reward.

subject: Great Fairy Fountain
text: Blowing up the hidden wall near the gray rock behind Lord Jabu-Jabu reveals a Fairy Temple to learn Farore's Wind.

evidence.quote: Behind Lord Jabu Jabu to the right is a single gray rock you cannot blow up, however you can blow up the hidden wall around the silver rock leading to a hidden Fairy Temple.
